pyspoc.statistics.basic module¶

class Covariance(*args, **kwargs)¶

Bases: Statistic

Computes a variety of covariance statistics for static datasets (n x p) returning a p x p matrix. If a time series (n x p x t) is provided, dynamic covariance will be returned instead as a p x p x t tensor. Information on covariance estimators can be found at: https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/covariance.html
